Manage all types of vehicles and equipment in one place.
Car, Motorcycle, Bus, Truck, Airplane, Boat, Tractor, Generator

Complete fleet management for personal or business use

• FOR PERSONAL USE:
Drivvo - Vehicle Management is the free version of the application for personal use. It allows you to have total control over your vehicle costs: refueling, maintenance, oil changes and other services performed in the car, motorcycle, truck or bus.
For personal use and for professionals who use their vehicle for work (Uber, taxi, Cabify, 99, Didi) 

You can now manage vehicles and equipment using an Hour Meter!

• FOR CORPORATE USE:
Drivvo is a system for managing vehicle fleets, which gives the manager total control over vehicles and drivers. Track all refueling, expenses and services, schedule all appointments for each vehicle and driver.

Now you can fully manage your fleet, tracking Refuelings, Expenses, Maintenance (preventive and corrective), Income, Routes, Checklists and Reminders.

• REFUELING
Fuel control is the most important part of managing your vehicle. With the application, you can fill in the refueling data in real time, giving more agility to the management.
The resource allows you to easily identify if there is a problem with the vehicle and if there is a need for maintenance.

• CHARGING FOR ELECTRIC AND HYBRID VEHICLES
Electric and hybrid vehicles are covered too: log charges, track consumption in mi/kWh, and manage energy costs — all in one app.

• CHECKLIST
Create custom forms to run inspections on your vehicles, ensuring your vehicle is roadworthy. This reduces the risk of mechanical problems in remote or unfamiliar locations.
The vehicle checklist helps you identify and fix safety issues before they become dangerous. Items such as brakes, tires, lights and seat belts can be checked regularly to ensure the vehicle is in safe operating condition.

• EXPENSE
Drivvo allows you to have total control over your vehicle's expenses, registering taxes, insurance, fines, parking, among other expenses.

• SERVICE
Oil changes, brake checks, tire changes, filters, air conditioning cleaning. All these services can be easily viewed in the app.

• INCOME
Drivvo also makes it possible to record income, to make life easier for drivers who use their vehicle as a work tool, such as transport app drivers, for example.

• ROUTE
Keep a record of all trips that are made on a day-to-day basis.
If you use your vehicle for work and are paid per kilometer driven, Drivvo helps you organize and calculate your travel reimbursements.
It makes it easier for the fleet manager to identify the driver who was behind the wheel.

• REMINDER
Having scheduled preventive maintenance is another fundamental activity in managing your vehicle.
With the help of the app, you can set reminders to track regular services such as oil changes, tire replacements, inspections and tune-ups — scheduled by mileage or date.

• FLEET MANAGEMENT
Drivvo is a vehicle fleet management system that gives the fleet manager full control over vehicle and driver data.

results.description:
Vehicle Maintenance Tracker (VMT) is a simple yet powerful tool designed to help you keep a complete history of your vehicles’ maintenance. Whether you're tracking a single car or managing a fleet, VMT makes it easy to stay organized and informed.

Key Features:
*Add and update vehicle details, including photo, VIN, license plate, year, make, model, tire size, oil filter type, current odometer, and annual maintenance costs.
*Set, view, and reset due dates for upcoming services.
*Archive vehicles you no longer own and restore or permanently delete them at any time.
*Manage maintenance records for multiple vehicles—oil changes, brakes, tires, batteries, and more.
*Attach photos of maintenance receipts for better documentation.
*Search and filter maintenance records easily.
*Maintenance entries are organized and sorted chronologically for quick reference.
*Export or email vehicle data in CSV format for printing or sharing.

I hope you enjoy using VMT as much as I enjoyed building it. If you have any questions, feedback, or suggestions, feel free to reach out—and don't forget to join the **VMT community on Facebook**! It's the best way to connect with me and other users, get updates, and suggest new features.

Happy Tracking!

results.description:
Fuelio is a simple, easy-to-use fuel tracker for your mileage, fuel consumption, and car expenses. Just log your odometer reading and how much fuel you bought at each fill-up, and Fuelio calculates your fuel economy and keeps a full fuel log, with clear charts and statistics for one car or a small fleet.

Find nearby gas stations and compare gas prices right from CarPlay, so you always know where to refuel for less. Glance at your dashboard from a Home Screen widget, or report a missing or incorrect gas station from the app.

Generate a Seller's report or a Custom report in a few taps, handy when selling a car or filing an expense claim.

Fuelio Premium turns Fuelio into a complete expense tracker for your car, covering maintenance, insurance, repairs, parking, tolls, car washes, and more. It also unlocks maintenance reminders, camera receipt scanning that works instantly on your device, even offline, weather logging on fill-ups, and three deeper report types: Annual Summary, Fuel Efficiency, and Maintenance.

Supports every major fuel type — Gasoline, Diesel, Electric, LPG, CNG, Ethanol — including bi-fuel vehicles with two tanks. Distance, volume, and consumption units are available for every region.

Add as many vehicles as you want, each with its own units, and import or export your data as CSV any time.

Your data stays on your device, with optional automatic iCloud Drive backup. No account required, no ads.

Fuel prices are provided by users and third-party sources (or official government providers in some countries) and may not reflect current station rates. We are not responsible for their accuracy or availability.

Terms of use: https://fuel.io/termsofuse.html
